findings.description: Use of floating-point for monetary calculations can produce rounding errors. Prefer decimal.Decimal for currency calculations to ensure accuracy, especially for financial applications.

Both calculate_total and format_receipt iterate over the 'items' parameter. If 'items' is a one-shot iterable (e.g., a generator), calculate_total will consume it, and format_receipt will see an exhausted iterator, resulting in a receipt with no line items. Convert 'items' to a list at the beginning or otherwise materialize it once to avoid this.

The functions assume every item is a dictionary with 'price' and 'name' keys and that 'price' is numeric. Missing keys or non-numeric values will cause unhandled KeyError or TypeError. Add validation to provide clear error messages.
